name: MD Jahedul Alam
title: Founder & Managing Director
bio: MD Jahedul Alam founded MEDI-Q in 2012 with a vision to bridge the gap between international medical device manufacturers and Bangladesh's growing healthcare sector. With over two decades of experience in medical goods trading, he has built MEDI-Q into one of Bangladesh's most trusted medical import companies, pioneering the country's largest nebulizer range and establishing partnerships with leading manufacturers across Europe and Asia.
shortBio: Founder with 20+ years in medical goods trading. Established MEDI-Q in 2012.
